summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a 6-K furnishing a September 11, 2026 press release announcing a five-year Government of Canada contract to supply Low-Cost Tactical ISR UAS to the Canadian Armed Forces. The initial firm commitment covers 100 systems plus ground control stations, payloads, data links, support equipment, documentation, spares and training. Canada retained a sole-discretion option for up to 4,900 additional systems, aggregating roughly C$24.25 million if fully exercised. This is a routine commercial contract award, not a special situation; no securities, ownership or deal terms are implicated.
